examples.name: Default
examples.summary: One shell command with the `$` prompt and a copy button, sized for a hero's actions row.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import SectionCommand from '@aziontech/webkit/section-command'
</script>

<template>
  <SectionCommand value="npm create azion@latest" />
</template>

examples.name: Prompt
examples.summary: With `shell` off the line is a prompt for an AI agent: no `$`, and the field and copy button are named Prompt.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import SectionCommand from '@aziontech/webkit/section-command'
</script>

<template>
  <SectionCommand
    :shell="false"
    value="Deploy this repository to Azion and give me the URL"
  />
</template>
